title: Input-fold machine
statement: Let $A$ be a state space, let $\Gamma$ be an input alphabet, let $k$ be the number of work tapes, let $\delta:A\to\Gamma\to A$ be an update rule, and let $a_0\in A$. The machine starts in a forward phase carrying $a_0$. In that phase, on reading $\gamma\in\Gamma$, it moves the input head right and replaces its carried value $a$ by $\delta(a,\gamma)$; on a blank cell it moves left and enters the backward phase carrying $a$. In the backward phase it moves left on symbols and right on a blank cell to enter the completed phase, preserving the carried value; in the completed phase it stays put. It performs no work-tape actions and emits no output.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
